concerns.text: The plan states that the full sweep (5 seeds × 3 α × 5 ε = 75 configurations, each up to 50 communication rounds) will complete within the 6‑hour CPU budget of a GitHub Actions free‑tier runner. Even with the optimistic 30 s per round estimate, the worst‑case wall‑clock time exceeds 30 h, and Opacus DP overhead on CPU further increases runtime. This makes the compute budget claim infeasible under the free‑tier constraints.
